identity.source: Colors and forms measured from the owner's original assets (wall1-3, E mark, throne, wordmark). Nothing here is redrawn or substituted.
identity.note: The scheme neutrals are the measured violet-blacks lightened and desaturated; the accent family is derived from the measured magenta-violet. Silver is reserved for logo art and highlights.

color_schemes.generator: scripts/gen-color-schemes.py (writes both .colors files and audits every foreground/background pair: text >= 4.5:1, focus ring >= 3:1)

logo_usage.start_button_classic: E mark, colored variant (E Logo-2): the white variant has ~1.1:1 contrast on the light Classic panel
logo_usage.start_button_modern: throne symbol, colored variant (Throne-2): keeps the silhouette readable at 24-48 px on the dark Modern panel
logo_usage.monochrome_variants: reserved for light-on-dark print/export; never used as an icon on a light surface
logo_usage.clear_space: at least 1/8 of the artwork height on every side; never stretched, recolored or placed on a busy photographic area

wallpapers.policy: Installed as native KPackage wallpapers (/usr/share/wallpapers). Originals are shipped byte-identical at their own size (1672x941); Plasma scales at runtime. The default is declared only in the look-and-feel [Wallpaper] defaults (plus lock/login); nothing re-applies it at login and a profile switch restores the user's own choice.

radius_px.note: In QML derive radii from Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing (control = x1.5, surface = x2, overlay = x3) so they follow scale; never a bare number.

elevation.policy: Surfaces are separated by Kirigami.Theme.alternateBackgroundColor and a 1px separator (Kirigami.Theme.textColor at 15% opacity); shadows belong to the compositor (Plasma popups, floating panel), never to in-app cards.

panel.note: Classic: solid, full-width, menu at the left, clock with date. Modern: floating, cluster centered, clock with time only. Both >= 44px so pointer and touch targets stay comfortable.

launcher.note: Uses the native kicker models; all colors come from the active Enthroned scheme (no hardcoded colors). The profile layout script writes the icon (General/icon) on every layout reset, on the launcher and on the kickoff fallback alike.

profile_tool.note: Snapshots the user's wallpaper(s) per screen before the switch and writes them back after, so a profile switch never resets a personal choice.

desktop_trash.note: Added to the desktop containment by the look-and-feel layout scripts; user-removable.

folder_icons.note: Violet two-tone folders replace the former amber ones; same tonal roles, white glyphs unchanged.

splash.note: Both profiles use the deep violet of the default wallpaper so there is no light/dark flash between splash and desktop; the logo is the original wordmark.

typography.policy: Do not override system fonts; Plasma font settings remain user-owned.
typography.source: Native KDE font stack; no bundled font.

roles.secondary: Label with Kirigami.Theme.disabledTextColor (Kirigami maps it to the scheme's ForegroundInactive, >= 4.5:1 on Window, View, Button and alternate surfaces in both schemes)
roles.caption: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont

motion.policy: Kirigami.Units durations follow the global Plasma animation speed, so users who turn animations off get zero-duration transitions. No permanent animations; indeterminate indicators only while real work is in progress.

states.focus: DecorationFocus ring, 2px (Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 2), always visible on keyboard focus
states.hover: highlightColor at 10% opacity over the surface (DecorationHover for borders)
states.selected: highlightColor at 16% opacity plus a 3px accent indicator bar (selection never relies on color alone)

semantic.positive: Kirigami.Theme.positiveTextColor / positiveBackgroundColor (always paired with an icon and a text label)

notes: All colors map to KConfig keys in the .colors schemes; components must not hardcode colors (the splash backgrounds are the one documented exception: they render before any scheme is loaded).

Lote 13 audit: 268 pairs (134 per scheme) across Window, View, Button, Header, Tooltip, Complementary and Selection sets all meet WCAG 2.1 AA text contrast (4.5:1); the focus ring and the Selection/highlight color (progress bars, switches, sliders, accent bars) meet 3:1 against the surfaces they sit on. Static computation from the .colors files by scripts/gen-color-schemes.py --check.
Contrast was computed statically; it has not been confirmed in a running Plasma session.
Reversibility: users can switch back to any installed scheme via System Settings > Colors.
